case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO.3259 OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (CIVIL) NO. 16932 OF 2018) AND CIVIL APPEAL NO.3260 OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (CIVIL) NO. 18074 OF 2018)
summary: Arbitration clause enforceability; scope of Section 8 of Arbitration Act; dispute arising from licensing agreements concerning payment of quarterly fees, bonuses, and mortgage-backed advances; supplementary and tripartite agreements analyzed; High Court error in dismissing applications to refer disputes to arbitration; non-arbitrability not established under 'action in rem' doctrine; matters remanded for arbitration.
final_judgment: Leave granted; High Court judgment set aside; Commercial Court directed to refer disputes to arbitration.
